title: Recovery of coefficients for a convection-diffusion equation from partial data
summary: This article is devoted to the inverse problem of determining the zeroth- and first-order coefficients, depending on both the time and space variables, in a parabolic equation from partial boundary measurements of the flux generated by Dirichlet excitations.
